presets.name: 森林小徑

presets.name: 杉木林間
presets.prompt: Straight cedar trunks form repeating vertical layers above a level forest floor covered with fallen needles. A broad textured trunk occupies the foreground, with smaller trees receding behind.

presets.name: 竹林石徑
presets.prompt: A stone walkway through a dense bamboo grove, surrounded by upright green stalks and layered leaves. Low bamboo branches border the path, with clear gaps between the stems into the background.

presets.name: 苔蘚林地倒木

presets.name: 森林木棧道

presets.name: 林間溪畔踏石

presets.name: 林間野餐空地

presets.name: 林間吊橋

presets.name: 晨霧森林

presets.name: 林間木屋門口
presets.prompt: A small timber cabin in the woods, with an open doorway, weathered boards and a broad wooden doorframe. Ferns grow beside the threshold and forest trees fill the space beyond the cabin.

presets.name: 公園草地
